method: Read official fixed-commit GitHub source over allowed normal proxy hosts. Full Azure document read; focused ranges of the other downloaded complete files read. No production files were changed during the initial read-only phase.

quotes.text: Implement a facade or adapter layer between different subsystems that don't share the same semantics.
Communication between subsystem A and the anti-corruption layer always uses the data model and architecture of subsystem A.
the core purpose of an anti-corruption layer is to protect the domain model

sources.adopted: Business-facing communication can use the business model; external-facing calls use the external model. An adapter can provide translation at a protective boundary.
sources.limits: Adapter and anti-corruption layer are not synonyms. ACL is a domain-protection architectural purpose and can contain an adapter or facade. This example does not claim to implement a complete production ACL. Document discussion of latency, maintenance and semantic differences also applies; no blanket need for an ACL for every wrapper.

quotes.text: Adapter that takes a JDK {@code java.util.concurrent.Executor} and exposes a Spring {@link org.springframework.core.task.TaskExecutor} for it.

sources.adopted: Actual target interface implementation, held Executor, constructor wiring, delegation and defined exception translation support a concrete object-adapter example.
sources.limits: A pinned main-branch read snapshot, not a stable-release recommendation or universal notification/failure semantics. Rejected execution does not justify translating notification uncertainty to rejection.

quotes.text: This method is intended to help adapt code that produces {@code Enumeration} instances to code that consumes {@code Iterator} instances.

sources.adopted: Adaptation is about the consumer target contract and delegation, with unavailable remove capability remaining unsupported.
sources.limits: Anonymous class captures the outer Enumeration rather than explicitly declaring a delegate field. Source interfaces need not be called a vendor SDK, nor must a historical upgrade crisis trigger the design.

quotes.text: A {@code FilterInputStream} wraps some other input stream, which it uses as its basic source of data, possibly transforming the data along the way or providing additional functionality.

sources.adopted: Wrapping/holding/delegating alone is not sufficient to identify an adapter: this official wrapper preserves the InputStream contract.
sources.limits: The source does not declare a GoF classification. The conclusion is about an insufficient structural test, not a claim that the file formally defines all wrappers or decorators.

conclusions: Business may proactively define a stable Notifier contract and adapt external SDKs to it; the story need not start with a legacy-interface accident.
An adapter can provide translation at an anti-corruption boundary; it is not automatically a full ACL and not every wrapper is an adapter.

With unchanged and still-realizable business semantics, SDK input/receipt format changes can be localized to integration mapping, dependencies/configuration and external creation/wiring. The business caller source can stay unchanged.
Technical adaptation cannot invent unavailable delivery, idempotency, cancellation or recipient-lookup capabilities, or hide a changed definition of acceptance.
